title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — October 17, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.7 (Peaked October 17, 2026 at 00:48 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 471 km/s (Elevated)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)

The solar wind has a little extra pep. 💨🌞

Solar images show two visible active regions and a prominent elongated dark coronal feature, while the coronagraph view shows no obvious large outward structure.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
